scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana was launched by the Government of Rajasthan on 1st April 2021. 

This scheme aims to enhance the income of farmers and promote horticulture in the state. 

The mission is part of the broader initiative to improve agricultural productivity and provide sustainable livelihoods to farmers. 

The objectives of the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission include increasing the area under horticulture crops by 20 percent by the year 2025. 

The scheme also aims to improve the income of farmers engaged in horticulture by 50 percent over the next five years. 

Additionally, it seeks to create a robust supply chain for horticultural products to reduce post-harvest losses. 

The mission is expected to benefit around 1.5 million farmers across Rajasthan. 

Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers for the cultivation of various horticultural crops. 

Farmers can receive up to INR 50,000 per hectare for the cultivation of fruits and vegetables. 

The assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy which covers 50 percent of the total cost of cultivation. 

The scheme also includes provisions for the establishment of nurseries and production units for quality planting materials. 

Farmers can receive a subsidy of up to INR 1 lakh for setting up a nursery. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission also emphasizes the importance of training and capacity building for farmers. 

Training programs are organized to educate farmers about modern horticultural practices and technologies. 

The government collaborates with agricultural universities and research institutions to provide these training sessions. 

Eligibility criteria for the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission include being a resident of Rajasthan. 

Farmers must also possess a minimum of 0.5 hectares of land to qualify for the benefits under this scheme. 

The age limit for applicants is set at 18 years and above. 

Income criteria specify that the annual income of the farmer should not exceed INR 2 lakh. 

The application process for the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission is straightforward. 

Farmers must fill out the application form available at the local agriculture department offices. 

The required documents include proof of land ownership, identity proof, and income certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the agriculture department officials. 

Farmers are required to provide a bank account number for the disbursement of subsidies. 

The timeline for application submission is open throughout the year. 

However, farmers are encouraged to apply during the pre-sowing season to avail of timely assistance. 

Disbursement of subsidies is typically done within 30 days of the approval of the application. 

The implementing authority for the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission is the Department of Horticulture, Government of Rajasthan. 

Farmers can contact the department through their official website or visit local offices for assistance. 

The contact details for the Department of Horticulture can be found on the Rajasthan government’s official portal. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission also includes provisions for marketing support for horticultural products. 

Farmers are provided with access to various markets and platforms to sell their produce. 

The government organizes fairs and exhibitions to promote horticultural products. 

This initiative helps farmers to connect with potential buyers and increase their sales. 

The mission also aims to promote organic farming practices among farmers. 

Farmers are encouraged to adopt organic methods of cultivation to improve the quality of their produce. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission is a significant step towards achieving sustainable agricultural practices in Rajasthan. 

The scheme is aligned with the National Horticulture Mission launched by the Government of India in 2005. 

The National Horticulture Mission aims to promote holistic growth of the horticulture sector. 

It focuses on increasing production, improving post-harvest management, and enhancing marketing. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission complements these national efforts by providing state-specific support. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the agricultural landscape of Rajasthan. 

By focusing on horticulture, it aims to diversify the income sources for farmers. 

This diversification is crucial in reducing the risks associated with traditional agriculture. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission also emphasizes the importance of water conservation. 

Farmers are encouraged to adopt drip irrigation and other water-saving technologies. 

This focus on sustainable practices is essential in the context of Rajasthan’s water scarcity issues. 

The mission also aims to create employment opportunities in the horticulture sector. 

It is expected to generate around 500,000 jobs over the next five years. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission is a comprehensive initiative that addresses multiple aspects of horticulture. 

From financial assistance to training and marketing support, it provides a holistic approach. 

The scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the economic development of rural areas in Rajasthan. 

By empowering farmers, it aims to uplift their standard of living and improve food security. 

The Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission is a testament to the Rajasthan government's commitment to agricultural development. 

It reflects the importance of horticulture in achieving sustainable development goals. 

Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of this scheme to enhance their agricultural practices. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the progress of the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the objectives of the scheme are being met. 

Feedback from farmers is also collected to improve the implementation of the scheme. 

Overall, the Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana represents a significant investment in the future of horticulture in Rajasthan. 

It aims to create a thriving horticultural sector that benefits both farmers and consumers alike.
